subject: Public utilities: electric utilities
bill.title: Public utilities: electric utilities; project labor agreements and prevailing wage and fringe benefit rates; require for certain data center contracts. Amends 1939 PA 3 (MCL 460.1 - 460.11) by adding sec. 10ii.

posted_text:
💵 Labor & Workers' Rights
MI SB 1048 — Data Centers Could Face New Labor Rules in Michigan

Michigan is changing how electric utilities handle contracts for data centers. Starting soon, the state's Public Utilities Commission will need to approve any deals between utilities and data center companies if the project uses registered apprenticeship programs and pays workers a wage at least as high as the local prevailing wage rate – as determined by state law. ...
